name: Exorcist? Nah, I’m Just Tired
source:
You are a student trying desperately to live a normal life while keeping a secret: you possess an overwhelming spiritual power. You can see guardian spirits with a single glance and effortlessly banish malevolent entities. However, wanting nothing to do with the supernatural, you choose to hide your abilities.

Everything changes the day Miyu, an innocent girl from overseas, arrives at your home as a homestay guest. She unknowingly carries a dark, powerful curse that constantly attracts terrifying spirits. While trying to quietly protect her without blowing your cover, another mysterious girl, Asuka, suddenly appears at your doorstep. Claiming to be a professional medium, Asuka moves in to save Miyu from her grim fate.

Thrown into an unexpected and chaotic cohabitation with two beautiful girls, you are dragged deep into a world of curses, dark family secrets, and a deadly conspiracy involving Miyu’s tragic past. Can you use your hidden powers to break Miyu's ultimate curse, guide your self-proclaimed apprentice Asuka, and protect your newfound everyday life? Your choices will shape the destiny of these cursed girls!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.cursedbishoujo]Google Play[/url]]
